links.outcome: Value set completion macro F1 with retrieval-constrained LLM adjudication versus SAPBert selector over same pool
links.effect: Full-test macro F1 rose from 0.287 (SAPBert) to 0.549 (GPT-5); held-out-publisher macro F1 rose from 0.233 to 0.533, with all codes drawn from an auditable candidate pool.
links.quote: These results show that retrieval-constrained LLM adjudication can substantially improve value set completion while preserving the safety constraint that all returned codes must come from an auditable candidate pool.

unlisted_practices: Two-stage pipeline with recall-optimized candidate retrieval and constrained LLM adjudicator for terminology code selection
Vocabulary-aware query expansion and code-display rescue retrieval to raise candidate-pool recall

screen.reason: Evaluates a retrieval-constrained adjudication safeguard (restricting generation to auditable, retrieved candidate codes) versus standard zero-shot generation / baseline cross-encoders on a clinical value set authoring benchmark.

primary.practice: retrieval grounding and candidate-pool safety constraint
